## Core Offer & Risk Reversal
- **48-Hour Live Prototype:** Staging UI or RAG AI workflow ready to test within 48 hours.
- **50/50 Grand Slam Guarantee:** Clients pay 50% upfront to initiate architecture. The final 50% is paid ONLY after testing the live sub-second system on staging.

## 3 Core Engineering Pillars
1. **High-Converting Web & Full-Stack Product Engineering:** Custom E-Commerce Storefronts (1-Click bKash/Stripe/COD Funnels), SaaS Web Apps, and Scalable Backends using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, React, Next.js 15, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **Technical SEO & Sub-Second Speed Optimization:** Semantic HTML5 architecture, Core Web Vitals optimization (100/100 PageSpeed, < 0.8s LCP), JSON-LD Schema markup, programmatic SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
3. **Custom AI Agents & Business Workflow Automation:** RAG-trained Knowledge Base Agents, 24/7 Automated Customer Support (Web, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord), OpenClaw browser workflows, and B2B Lead Generation.

## Key Case Studies & Shipped Projects
- **Edel Bangladesh (Luxury E-Commerce & F-Commerce):** [https://cryptowebbuild.github.io/edel-bangladesh/](https://cryptowebbuild.github.io/edel-bangladesh/) — 0.4s load time, 1-click bKash/COD order form, automated Steadfast Courier API sync, +240% mobile order lift.
- **ShopFast Headless Storefront:** 100/100 Speed Score, 0.4s load, client-side cart, Stripe/bKash checkout, +216% conversion boost.
- **Vanguard B2B Analytics SaaS:** High-concurrency financial analytics dashboard built with React, D3.js, Python/Django REST API, and PostgreSQL querying 10M+ rows with <50ms response.
- **ClickRunClaw AI Cloud Engine:** [https://clickrunclaw.com/](https://clickrunclaw.com/) ([Case Study](https://cryptowebbuild.com/clickrunclaw)) — Flagship AI SaaS product providing managed 24/7 cloud runtime for OpenClaw & RAG AI agents with instant webhook provisioning.
- **AutoGit Edge Deployer:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/autogithub](https://cryptowebbuild.com/autogithub) — Client-side DevOps engine deploying static sites directly from the browser via GitHub API.
- **SolNova Protocol:** [https://cryptowebbuild.com/tokenlaunch](https://cryptowebbuild.com/tokenlaunch) — Solana presale aggregation dashboard with Phantom/Solflare wallet sync and live RPC telemetry.
- **Apex Corporate B2B Funnel:** High-authority corporate lead generation platform scoring 100/100 on Google PageSpeed with Schema.org JSON-LD.
